claim: You can create durable functions for Node.js, Python, Java and C# (.NET) using managed runtimes; durable functions are also available through OCI container images.

evidence.quote: Durable functions are available for selected managed runtimes and OCI container images for additional runtime version flexibility. You can create durable functions for Node.js, Python, Java, and C\# (.NET) using managed runtimes directly in the console or programmatically through infrastructure-as-code.

note: adjudicate-18: currency vote outdated (FAQ listed JavaScript, TypeScript, Python and Java, before the .NET SDK GA of 2026-07-23). Re-grounded in the guide page Supported runtimes for durable functions (fetched 2026-10-13). C# (.NET) support is after 2026-07-15: not examinable yet.
